entries.title: Crewmates read GitLab pipelines, and your merge requests join Open changes
entries.body: On projects on gitlab.com or your own GitLab server, a crewmate can now read a failed job's log, save the files the job kept, and ask GitLab directly about its own project, with the key you made there. If Firstmate made you a panel of your open changes, it now lists your GitLab merge requests beside your GitHub pull requests, each numbered the way GitLab numbers it, with its pipeline's status.

picture.alt: The Open changes panel listing a GitLab merge request, !1, above three GitHub pull requests
